notes.title: Devlog #2 Demo, development progress and hot-dog trailer
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone [/b]

During this week, a large amount of content was added to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39317263/d7d8a93a647fabb8f93b70fb75df051664b44cd2.png[/img]

Now each restaurant will have its own unique background, everything used to happen on the green grass, but now the city is a city. Soon passers-by will start walking the streets and stopping by your restaurant.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39317263/00ba217b986b1128582f4f9c2107d7c682d5a498.png[/img]

In the city, you can place your own trailers with hot dogs, cotton candy and more than your heart desires. There is an interface for buying and placing food trailers. A separate menu will be under their settings. Each trailer is specific mini-game, different from managing a full-fledged restaurant.

It will also be possible to make the food trailers more independent, so that the staff itself manages sales and brings you passive income.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39317263/e0f31add2cef2a3e2b51129b316ee709605001e1.png[/img]

After a certain period of time, you will have to pay taxes. The UI will be more detailed and detailed, but even now the money is perfectly debited from your account.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39317263/73c3d9407d7219cc5c3c188ee26b40a0ae22366f.png[/img]

Cars appeared on the streets of the city! Maybe you can even buy them for yourself??

Thank you for reading! Add the game to your wish lists, [b]after all, a short demo will be released soon[/b], where you can try to interact with several game mechanics on your own.

[b]Subscribe to Twitter to get first-hand development news: [/b]https://twitter.com/NorskaStudios

notes.title: Devlog # 1 What is the game about? What's going on now?
notes.content:
Game development began in the middle of this year. The original idea was to create a simple cooking game with unusual controls. It was necessary to independently move the products, mix them and get ready meals.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39317263/324b909619ccea59592dc88b4aa83b85feda3a5d.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39317263/324b909619ccea59592dc88b4aa83b85feda3a5d.gif[/img][/url]
[u]GIF image of the very first prototype[/u]

And this is how the restaurant looks now.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39317263/2de1ccd04850c51ee8855e2c6b73a87cc6e77b59.png[/img]

Later, the concept changed a lot, there were ideas to make a Sim in a restaurant. The game is developing in approximately this direction. The player will be able to buy restaurants, repair them, hire and control staff, and he will also be able to do all this on his own, even cook with his own hands.

At this moment [b](12.12.2020)[/b] there is an active pfase of reworking of the interface of one of the cities available in the game. The interface becomes clear and more interactive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39317263/69279d0c769180e5b28e1e3fa49e1e218bc33935.png[/img]
[u]Shop interface[/u]

Development is progressing at a good pace. The plans for the near future are to complete the interface refinement and proceed to the introduction of social elements of the characters' interaction. I'll tell you about this next time :)
